name: Futage Age of futanari: Captain Greerin
source:
In a world mirroring our own, a catastrophic virus transformed every woman into a futanari and nearly eradicated men, leaving only a few immune survivors.

A society driven by near-uncontrollable desire and lust.

A visual novel following Junior Agent Emilia Katz as she delivers a critical package to her cunning captain, Violet Greerin.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3985010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一个与我们相似的世界中，一种灾难性的病毒将每个女性都变成了扶他那人，并几乎消灭了男性，只留下了少数免疫幸存者。

一个由几乎无法控制的欲望和情欲驱动的社会。

这是一部视觉小说，讲述了初级特工艾米莉亚·卡茨向她狡猾的船长维奥莱特·格里林递送一个重要包裹的故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3985010/]Steam[/url]]
